title: Both Together
translation: One who knows both, knowledge and ignorance, together, crosses death through ignorance (action) and attains immortality through knowledge.
translation_hi: जो विद्या और अविद्या दोनों को एक साथ जानता है, वह अविद्या (कर्म) से मृत्यु को पार करके विद्या से अमरता प्राप्त करता है।
science: Knowledge and action together: theory without practice, or practice without theory, falls short, a point every engineer knows.
